output.reason: [ev-f7d3abb12e99] is a one-line changelog entry under Enhancements that only says metrics now support gRPC and gRPC-Web. It does not say metrics endpoints "accept and process requests" over gRPC, so the proposed statement reads more into the entry than it says. It also does not say whether anything existing changes, for example new label values in metrics for gRPC traffic, which would make this a behavior-change rather than a pure addition (none). The rest of the Enhancements section and the upgrade guide add nothing on this. To decide the consequence I would need the PR #9483 description or the metrics docs showing whether existing metric series or labels change.
